title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs site quickstarts
author: Priya Nair
description: Adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, new tool-calling examples for Python and TypeScript, and updates to the docs site quickstarts. Motivation: provide customers with production-ready examples for composing RAG agents and integrating tool-calling into end-to-end apps. The change includes: 1) templated RAG playbooks (search + synthesize + cite) with configurable retrieval backends (vector DB and Redwood embeddings), 2) a Python tool-calling example demonstrating safe tool interfaces, structured outputs, and retries, 3) a TypeScript agent example using the SDK and streaming responses, 4) docs site quickstart pages that walk through running the examples locally, deploying to Redwood Dedicated/Private, and recommended production settings (batching, caching, quantization profiles). The description below lists commits, files changed, CI results, and review threads. This PR is intentionally scoped to examples and docs only (no runtime code changes). Related: ENG-4123 (RAG quickstart spec), previous examples PRs pr-63678 and pr-63699.
